items.desc_now: A DeepSeek Harness web UI plugin for customizing and managing the settings navigation drawer. DeepSeek Harness 设置抽屉插件，用于自定义和管理设置页左侧导航栏，可隐藏/显示各设置栏目，修改即时生效。
dsh plugins: control a local DeepSeek Harness from your phone — tailscale point-to-point or your own VPS relay. One entry point: dsh --profile mobile
items.desc_prev: Remotely control a locally resident DeepSeek Harness (dsh) instance from any device via Tailscale point-to-point or a self-hosted VPS relay, with the native dsh Web UI/UX
